Name: Ticking Clockhand
Description: You quickly fling an ethereal clockhand toward a creature within reach by making a ranged spell attack. On a hit the target takes 1d6 piercing damage and suffers 2 Tremor.
At Higher Levels: This spell’s damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
